oneLiner: STPi hunts 76 job board families across 21 African markets every day, writes a cover letter and a tailored CV for every match, and sends only after a human taps approve.
definition: STPi is an AI job-search and placement system for recruiters, career coaches and boutique agencies in Africa: it finds the vacancies, drafts the application in the advert's own language, and sends from the candidate's own mailbox once a person approves it.
audience: Recruiters, career coaches and boutique placement agencies working in South Africa, Zimbabwe and Zambia

features.name: Hunt
features.detail: 76 job board families and 115 endpoints, including unindexed social posts and newspaper PDFs, across 21 African markets.

features.name: Draft
features.detail: A relevance score, a cover letter and a tailored CV per match, built only from the profile the recruiter approved.

features.name: Approve
features.detail: Cards arrive as 'Accountant at Acme, match 87%' and nothing sends without a human tap; drafts expire in 72 hours.

features.name: Send
features.detail: Print-ready PDFs attached, signed as the candidate, capped per candidate and per day.

features.name: Follow up
features.detail: Interview invites, questions, rejections and bounced addresses are reported back.

features.name: Employer side
features.detail: Persona cards, rubric-graded requirements backed by CV quotes, side-by-side compare and OmveoAgent shortlist briefs.

outcomes: Vacancies found daily across 76 board families and 115 endpoints
A tailored cover letter and CV per match, never invented facts
One approval tap per send, from the candidate's own mailbox
Replies routed back to the recruiter and the candidate

faqs.question: What is STPi?
faqs.answer: STPi is a recruitment automation system that hunts job boards across 21 African markets, drafts a tailored cover letter and CV for each match, and sends only after a human taps approve.

faqs.question: How much does STPi cost?
faqs.answer: The Done-For-You seat is $49 a month (R850 in South Africa). Studio is $613 a month, Solo is $306 a month and Sovereign is $920 a month for agencies running their own infrastructure. The CV Setup Pack is a one-off $19 (R350), and the demo is free forever at five deliveries a month.

faqs.question: Is there a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes. The demo runs the full hunt, draft and PDF pipeline with one active candidate and five deliveries per UTC month, free forever, with no sign-up form and no card.

faqs.question: Which job boards does STPi search?
faqs.answer: 76 job board families over 115 endpoints, including PNet, CareerJunction, Careers24, Bizcommunity, iHarareJobs, VacancyMail, JobsZimbabwe, GoZambiaJobs, UNjobs and Impactpool, plus unindexed social posts and newspaper PDFs.

faqs.question: Does STPi apply to jobs automatically?
faqs.answer: No. Every application waits for a human tap on an approval card; there is no automatic mode, and drafts delete themselves after 72 hours.

faqs.question: Will automated applications get a candidate's email flagged?
faqs.answer: STPi sends from the candidate's own mailbox with per-candidate and per-day caps, and only after approval, which is what keeps a normal sending pattern.

faqs.question: How does STPi help an employer facing hundreds of applicants?
faqs.answer: Every requirement in the advert becomes a rubric line graded against a quote from the CV, applicants appear as persona cards, and OmveoAgent prepares an interview shortlist with the evidence behind each name. The hiring manager still makes the call.

faqs.question: Where does STPi run, and who holds the data?
faqs.answer: STPi is installable software: pip install the wheel and run it on your own machine or server. Nothing about a candidate is held by STPi.
